proof_body:
by
  intro R _ I
  rw [Ideal.isPrimary_iff]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  constructor
  · intro h a b hab
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
    rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hab
    rcases h hab with hx | ⟨n, hn⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hx)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]; exact hn⟩
  · intro h x y hxy
    rcases h (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y) (by rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]; exact hxy) with hx | ⟨n, hn⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 hx)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨n, by rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hn; exact hn⟩
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R), I.IsPrimary ↔ I ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ a b : R ⧸ I, a * b = 0 → a = 0 ∨ IsNilpotent b
